checker_contract.acceptance: Accept only target-specific claims whose exact or interval certificates replay independently and preserve the stated source, divisor-exclusion, boundary, and equivalence conditions.
checker_contract.rejection: Reject floating-point residuals as certificates, source/reconstruction conflation, missing genericity or divisor exclusion, geometric equivalence drift, and every mechanical, manufacturing, novelty, priority, patentability, product, or commercial inference.

claim_boundary: The handoff requests bounded algebraic and planar-geometry certification only. It does not certify rigid foldability, collision freedom, finite thickness, manufacturability, product performance, novelty, priority, patentability, or commercial value.
